# OMORA BLOOMS

> Luxury handmade crochet and pipe-cleaner flower bouquets, gift boxes, mother recovery kits and baby essentials — everlasting blooms, never fresh flowers. Express 20-30 minute delivery at Kempegowda International Airport (BLR), Bengaluru.

OMORA BLOOMS is an Indian luxury gifting brand. Every bouquet is handmade with love and crafted to last forever. Orders can be placed online (Razorpay) or on WhatsApp.
